Danylo "Zeus" Teslenko (born October 8, 1987) is a retired Ukrainian professional Counter-Strike: Global Offensive and Counter-Strike player. He retired on September 14, 2019 after a 17 year long career, during which he won over 60 tournaments including four Counter-Strike Majors and a CS:GO Major Championship: PGL Major Kraków 2017.

Trivia

[edit]

Personal

[edit]
  • Sometimes referred to as "Danya" (or Даня in Russian Cyrillic) - a common nickname given to a person named Danylo or Daniil in Russian-speaking countries.

Awards

[edit]
  • Was ranked the 19th best player of 2010 by HLTV. [2]

Records

[edit]
  • He is the first player to make it to the grand finals of a Major with two different teams: making it to the finals of DreamHack Cluj-Napoca 2015 and MLG Columbus 2016 with Natus Vincere and PGL Krakow 2017 with Gambit Esports.
  • First Ukrainian player to win a Major, doing so at PGL Krakow 2017.
  • Zeus previously held the record for being the oldest major champion, winning PGL Major Kraków 2017 at 29 years and 289 days old before overtaken by karrigan, who won PGL Major Antwerp 2022 at 32 years and 42 days old.
